dealer.tagline: Precision German engineering, delivered with elite care.

about.headline: An authorised Volkswagen dealership, engineered around you.
paragraphs: Volkswagen Elite Motors is an authorised Volkswagen dealership located in Bangalore, India. Within a short period of time the dealership firm has done outstanding business and won the trust of its valued customers. Located strategically near Hosur Road junction, the dealership is easily accessible to auto consumers. We have new locations that are coming up in South Bangalore as well.
Elite Motors features a state-of-the-art auto showroom with a wide range of brand new and second-hand Volkswagen cars.

The dealership also provides Insurance and Finance solutions, special offers, Service & Repair facilities along with Test drives. Founded with the vision to deliver highest level of customer satisfaction, Elite Motors is supported by highly-skilled teams who work hard relentlessly to deliver superior customer service.

models.name: Tayron R-Line
models.description: The Tayron R-Line carries Volkswagen's flagship SUV design language into a seven-seat package — IQ.LIGHT HD Matrix LED headlamps, a 15-inch infotainment display and R-Line detailing throughout, wrapped around precision German engineering.

faqs.question: What engine options does the Tayron R-Line come with?
faqs.answer: The Tayron R-Line is offered with the 2.0L TSI EVO, producing 190 PS and 320 Nm, paired with 7-speed DSG.

faqs.question: How many variants of the Tayron R-Line are available?
faqs.answer: Elite Motors lists 1 variant of the Tayron R-Line, across the R-Line trim.

faqs.question: What is the price of the Tayron R-Line?
faqs.answer: The Tayron R-Line starts at ₹48,50,000 ex-showroom Bengaluru. Pricing is indicative — contact Elite Motors for on-road pricing.

faqs.question: What warranty does the Tayron R-Line carry?
faqs.answer: Your Volkswagen is secured with a 4 year (100,000 kilometers) manufacturer's warranty to ensure a peaceful ownership experience.

faqs.question: Does the Tayron R-Line have a sunroof?
faqs.answer: Yes — the Tayron R-Line is equipped with a panoramic sunroof.

faqs.question: Where can I service my Tayron R-Line in Bengaluru?
faqs.answer: At Volkswagen Elite Motors, SY No. 49/8-9, 10, Hosur Rd, Singasandra, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560100. Service hours are Mon - Sat 08:45–18:30; Sun 08:45–18:30.

faqs.question: Can I book a test drive of the Tayron R-Line?
faqs.answer: Yes. Test drives of the Tayron R-Line can be booked with Volkswagen Elite Motors on 080 4013 8004 or through the booking form on this site.

service_packages.intro: With our promise to deliver complete peace of mind for each of our customers, we have created Service Value Packages, that promise just that. These packages ensure your car is looked after by experts year-after-year without you having to worry about increasing costs. So while we add life to your car, you add money to your wallet with Volkswagen Service Value Packages.
